question.worked_solution:
Interpreting the fractions as division, we get

$$
(35\,÷\,6)\times (18\,÷\,7).
$$

 

Since our expression contains multiplication and division only, we can create an equivalent expression by swapping the $÷\,6$ and $÷\,7$:

$$
(35\,÷\,7)\times (18\,÷\,6)
$$

 

Interpreting the divisions as fractions, we get

$$
\frac{35}{7}\times \frac{18}{6}.
$$

Carrying out the divisions, we arrive at

$$
\begin{aligned}{{\frac{35}{7}}_{⏟}}_{5}\times {{\frac{18}{6}}_{⏟}}_{3}=5\times 3=15.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $\frac{35}{6}\times \frac{18}{7}=15.$
